channel.title: Nick Perkins — Reverend, Developer, Beloved by God
channel.description: A doorway to the Word, to Jesus, and to technical work in His service.

item.title: I am not Mr. Fix-It
item.description: I love solving problems. That is not the same as being the one who saves.

item.title: There's Good, And There's Best
item.description: The Spirit closes Asia and Bithynia — good doors, not wrong ones — so Paul can receive Macedonia. Good is not always best.

item.title: What's Stopping You?
item.description: The Spirit sends Philip to a desert road — and he rose and went. God is already drawing someone who cannot yet see Jesus in Isaiah.

item.title: Anyone Devoted, Many Will Believe
item.description: The kingdom advances through anyone devoted to Jesus — not through the credentials they carry. From Damascus to Joppa, devotion leaves a trail of belief.

item.title: Keep Moving Forward in Faith
item.description: In 2 Peter 1:1–11, believers stand equal by Christ's righteousness — already given everything for life and godliness — and are called to grow faith into love so calling is confirmed and entrance into the eternal kingdom richly provided.

item.title: Learning The Rhythm
item.description: After mission and grief, Jesus draws weary disciples aside — not away from the work forever, but into a rhythm that can sustain it.

item.title: Anxiety Hates This Sermon: From Panic to Praise
item.description: Faced with a coalition too vast to fight, Jehoshaphat turns Judah to fasting and prayer — eyes on the Lord when they do not know what to do — and hears that the battle is not theirs but God's.

item.title: Day of Diaspora: From Yall Come to We Go
item.description: Acts 14 is a Day of Diaspora — Antioch sends, God opens the door of faith, and the church learns that Christ builds not only by gathering but by going.

item.title: We Cannot But Pray
item.description: Released and threatened, they do not scatter into strategy — they run to their own and lift one voice to the Sovereign Lord.

item.title: We Cannot But Speak
item.description: The council sees ordinary men and cannot explain them — except that they had been with Jesus. What they have seen and heard will not stay quiet.

item.title: Who Stands Fast?
item.description: Hebrews 10:32–39 calls the church back to the days after they were enlightened — when they endured reproach and loss for a better possession — and urges them not to throw away their confidence, but to endure until the Coming One.

item.title: A Life of Praise
item.description: David's final recorded psalm — and the only one titled a Song of Praise — walks A to Z through the greatness of God. It resets despair, anxiety, and apathy with God-centered awe, and invites a life that answers His majesty with praise.
